title: AceDecay
description: Automatically decays blocks after a certain amount of time.
body:
# 🍂 AceDecay

Keep your PvP arenas clean with AceDecay! This plugin automatically removes player-placed blocks, water, and lava after a configurable amount of time. It is the ultimate tool for KitPvP, Practice, or BoxPvP servers.

---

## ✨ Features

* **⏳ Automated Block & Fluid Decay:** Every block, water, or lava source placed by players will automatically vanish after a specific countdown.
* **⚙️ Fully Customizable Timer:** Adjust the exact delay (in seconds) before blocks decay directly inside the configuration file.
* **🛡️ Smart Whitelist System:** Choose which specific block types are completely ignored by the decay system, allowing for permanent structures.
* **🎨 Creative Mode Protection:** Blocks placed by players in Creative Mode will never decay, allowing you to build maps without interference.
* **⚡ Live Build Bypass Toggle:** Administrators can bypass the decay system on the fly using the `/buildbypass` command (Requires OP or `acedecay.bypass`).
